POST /api/auth/login.description: Authenticate a user and return a JWT.

POST /api/auth/reset-password.description: Reset the user's password using a valid reset token.

GET /api/users/me.description: Return the currently authenticated user's information.

DELETE /api/users/me.description: Delete the currently authenticated user's account.

POST /api/profile.description: Create a profile for the authenticated user.

POST /api/relationship.description: Connect the authenticated user with another user using their relationship code.

response.201: You’re now connected on Memory Atlas ❤️

GET /api/relationship.description: Return the authenticated user's relationship and their partner's information.

PATCH /api/relationship.description: Update relationship details for the authenticated user's relationship.

POST /api/memory.description: Create a memory for the authenticated user's relationship.

GET /api/memory.description: Return all memories belonging to the authenticated user's relationship.

GET /api/memory/:id.description: Return a single memory by id, if it belongs to the authenticated user's relationship.

PATCH /api/memory/:id.description: Update a memory by id, if it belongs to the authenticated user's relationship.

DELETE /api/memory/:id.description: Delete a memory by id, if it belongs to the authenticated user's relationship.
